test_title: PYST 24: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Two bicycle riders started at a speed of 7 m/sec and 8 m/sec on a circular path in opposite directions at the same point. If the circumference of the circle is 300 m, then in what time will they first meet?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of first rider = 7 m/sec

Speed of second rider = 8 m/sec

Circumference of the circle = 300 m

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

**Calculation:**

Relative Speed = 7 + 8 = 15 m/sec

Distance to meet = Circumference = 300 m

⇒ Time = 300 / 15

⇒ Time = 20 sec

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**
